changeSet.author: refonte-messagerie
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE msg_reactions ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, messageId TEXT NOT NULL, personId TEXT NOT NULL, reaction TEXT NOT NULL, poseeLe TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE (tenantId, messageId, personId, reaction) )

changeSet.author: refonte-messagerie
changeSet.comment: Appels de groupe et leurs participants.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE msg_appels_groupe ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, conversationId TEXT NOT NULL, lanceParId TEXT NOT NULL, etat TEXT NOT NULL, lanceLe TEXT NOT NULL, debuteLe TEXT, termineLe TEXT )
CREATE INDEX idx_msg_appels_groupe_fil ON msg_appels_groupe (tenantId, conversationId, etat)

CREATE TABLE msg_appels_groupe_participants ( tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, appelId TEXT NOT NULL, personId TEXT NOT NULL, etat TEXT NOT NULL, rejointLe TEXT, partiLe TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, appelId, personId) )
